## Changes since v2.3.4

- Bound the handshake (TCP `63211`), lighting (UDP `63212`) and command (TCP `63213`) endpoints to `127.0.0.1`. MineLights Server and the Minecraft client now need to run on the same computer.
- Hardened client handshakes with a five-second timeout, a one-megabyte payload limit, complete-read validation, and per-connection handling for malformed or disconnected clients.
- Updated the network setup and troubleshooting notes for the local-only service endpoints and UDP discovery broadcast.
